brief: The canvas displays a complex, continuously evolving broadcast graphic composed of interconnected geometric planes, lines, and nodes. These structures drift slowly and rotate in three dimensions, with their glowing connections visibly pulsing whenever two planes approach a critical distance. The individual nodes and the intersections of the lines feature periodic bursts of bright glow. Supplementing the visualization, two distinct, legible text blocks—"You're watching" and "sketchgen TV"—drift slowly across the foreground.

statement: This sketch creates an immersive, evolving broadcast visualization using interconnected geometric planes that drift and rotate in three-dimensional space. The system features glowing connections that pulse when planes come close, creating a dynamic network effect. Bright bursts emanate from node intersections, while two text blocks drift slowly across the foreground for visual anchoring. The composition is rendered entirely in WebGL with optimized rendering techniques to maintain performance, using batched drawing operations and avoiding expensive per-frame calculations. Viewers experience a constantly shifting, luminous network of planes and connections that feels both organic and structured, evoking the aesthetic of digital broadcast systems or cosmic data visualization.
